description: Defines the KeyType enumeration and KeyInfoAttribute class used for specifying key value types and associated metadata in PDF processing within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: KeyInfoAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to annotate key information, including type, version, object type, and fixed value for PDF dictionary keys.

methods.name: KeyInfoAttribute
methods.description: Constructors for initializing KeyInfoAttribute with various combinations of version, key type, and object type.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Property to get or set the version string of the key info.

methods.name: KeyType
methods.description: Property to get or set the type of the key.

methods.name: ObjectType
methods.description: Property to get or set the associated object type for the key.

methods.name: FixedValue
methods.description: Property to get or set a fixed string value for the key.
